description: Pittston, PA - Congressman Rob Bresnahan’s campaign today announced that he has earned the endorsement of the the American Federation of Government Employees and the American Federation of Government Employees District 3. AFGE is the largest federal employee union in the country and AFGE District 3, which includes Pennsylvania and Delaware, represents nearly 33,000 federal employees across the two states.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Bresnahan Earns Endorsement of American Federation of Government Employees - Rob for PA
